from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, status
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from cart.schemas import CartCreate, CartRead
from cart.service import CartService
from common.db import get_db

router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/v1/carts", tags=["carts"])


@router.post("/", response_model=CartRead, status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
async def create_cart(
    payload: CartCreate,
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),
) -> CartRead:
    svc = CartService(db)
    cart = await svc.create(payload)
    return CartRead.model_validate(cart)


@router.get("/{cart_id}", response_model=CartRead)
async def get_cart(cart_id: int, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db)) -> CartRead:
    svc = CartService(db)
    cart = await svc.get(cart_id)
    if not cart:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="cart not found")
    return CartRead.model_validate(cart)
